P.HT: Decision of the Council of the European Union

TI.P: on the admission of the Republic of Bulgaria and Romania to the European Union

PREAMBLE.INIT.P: THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION,

GR.VISA.VISA: Having regard to the Treaty on European Union, and in particular Article 49 thereof,

Having regard to the opinion of the Commission
Opinion delivered on 22 February 2005 (not yet published in the Official Journal).,

Having regard to the assent of the European Parliament
Assent given on 13 April 2005 (not yet published in the Official Journal).,

CONSID.P: Whereas the Republic of Bulgaria and Romania have applied to become members of the European Union,

ENACTING.TERMS.P: to accept these applications for admission; the conditions of admission and the adjustments to the Treaties on which the European Union is founded, entailed by such admission, are to be the subject of an agreement between the Member States, the Republic of Bulgaria and Romania.
